Stufful

Normal Fighting

Alola · Generation 7

Stufful is a Normal/Fighting-type Flailing Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 6.8 kg. It evolves into Bewear. Its highest base stat is Attack (75), with a base stat total of 340.
